svg.title: Constellation Matrix architecture
svg.desc: Element connects privately through Tailscale Serve, which exposes the dashboard, Matrix, and the graph browser. Dot connects to the Matrix homeserver through the OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel and bridge. An optional bridge connects Telegram. Synapse uses PostgreSQL and delivers encrypted Office threads to Constellation Instances running Amplifier. Persona Workshop manages their profiles. Context Intelligence writes execution timelines to Neo4j.
